caption: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender chashu pork and a single nori sheet resting atop. Served in a white bowl with a spoon, it sits on a wooden table under warm, ambient lighting.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections near the glass.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with slight fat marbling and glistening surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough, uneven surface.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy yellow, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
White ceramic bowl with subtle floral pattern and smooth, glossy surface, slightly raised rim.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved bowl shape.
